verdict.rationale: ESD's own quarterly-reports page says employers "may file your quarterly tax and wage reports online" through EAMS, which is the core employer transaction. It also links step-by-step guides for setting up an EAMS account and filing a no-payroll report there. The probe confirms the transactional portal sits behind a SecureAccess Washington login, which is consistent with this rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: online tax payment is not documented, new-employer registration online is unevidenced, amended reports require a PDF submitted by email, mail or fax, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration of the authenticated filing flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: You may file your quarterly tax and wage reports online or by mail. Filing online reduces errors.
Watch this 2-minute video for a step-by-step guide to filing a no-payroll report in EAMS.
Employers and firms that represent employers can manage many tasks in eServices.
